data.name: Benkley
data.gender_notes: Benkley is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Benkley is derived from the Old English words 'ben' meaning 'hill' and 'cleh' meaning 'cliff' or 'rock'. This name can be interpreted as 'son of the hill' or 'son of the rock'. In Christian tradition, this name may be associated with the biblical figure Ben-Hur, who was a nobleman of the ancient city of Jerusalem and a protagonist in the novel 'Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ' by Lew Wallace.
data.etymology: Benkley belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of the hill.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benkley total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
